name: RL-18 18" 55W LED Ring Light (new version)

sources.title: NEEWER RL-18 New Version 18 Inch 55W LED Ring Light (Neewer product page, specifications)
sources.covers: LED count, power, maximum illumination, CRI, colour temperatures, ring diameter

note: Stated: "LED Qty: 240 | Power: 55W | Max Illumination: 5500lux at 0.5m | CRI: 95 | Color Temperature: 3200K & 5600K | Brightness Level: 0-100% | Ring Light Diameter: 18"/45cm". The two colour temperatures come from the included orange and white filters, so cct_k and cct_k_range are null (two values, not a range). emitting_size_m [0.45, 0.45] takes the stated 45 cm diameter as the ring's outer diameter, an ASSUMPTION (the page does not say outer or mean); the inner diameter is not stated. Not stated: luminous flux, luminance, beam angle, IR output, the light's own mass (the page lists the kit). The illuminance is on the axis at 0.5 m; DexVantage does not turn it into a flux or an intensity.
interface: Wired dimmer; Bluetooth remote (RT107, in the kit)
